start: ^No! I can't believe what I just saw with my own eyes. Grab the gun and lock the door.
resOne: ^At first I found one of the missing hikers, but then it was a demon that ended up chasing me!
resTwo: ^No I am not joking, and I am not crazy. This was for real. We need to stay inside here.

c-0: ^Okay, fine... but I'm exhausted, and I'm not staying up all night watching for some demon you might've imagined.

resThree: ^You and Marcus never seem to believe the things I see. Just wait until it's too late...

c-0: ^Yeah okay, well... Go to sleep. You can take the couch, I'll get some blankets out of the dresser and make a bed on the floor. If you have any issues just wake me up. But we're spending the night here for a reason, we need to rest so we can get back down to basecamp tomorrow and find help for Marcus.
